title: Laundry and Dry Cleaning Service Amendment 2
description_text: The Contractor shall operate and manage the Laundry Distribution and Collection Point(s) for the issue, receipt, requisition, exchange, warehousing, and turn-in of linens IAW AR 210-130, Laundry and Dry-Cleaning Operations; AR 710-4, Property Accountability; and other regulatory requirements. The Contractor shall maintain a contractor developed accountability system for linens and other items submitted for L&DC services IAW AR 710-2, Supply Policy Below the National Level; AR 710-4, Property Accountability; and other regulatory requirements. Amendment 0002 is to update the Response due date on the Solicitation SF 1449 document.
